ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: The route declares five dispositions and the packet delivers one, presenting the other four as belonging to no route. data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json, track il-seal-2yr, dispositions = ['supervision_successfully_completed', 'qualified_probation', 'conditional_discharge_completed_without_revocation', 'probation_completed_without_revocation', 'misdemeanor_conviction'], and its mechanism sentence reads 'a two-year sealing bucket effective June 1, 2026, covering successfully completed supervision, qualified probation, conditional discharge or probation completed without revocation, and misdemeanor convictions'. Its own requiredBeforeFiling line asks the participant to check the answer to 'For each case, was the outcome supervision, qualified probation, conditional discharge or probation completed without revocation, a misdemeanor conviction, or a felony conviction?' -- a multi-way question. The delivered Request page 5 prints all four two-year grounds: Section 16 (supervision, 2 years), Section 17 (misdemeanor conviction, 2 years), Section 18 (qualified probation / Cannabis Control Act Section 10 / Controlled Substances Act Section 410 / Meth Act Section 70 / Offender Initiative Program, 2 years) and Section 19.a (conditional discharge or probation completed without revocation, 2 years). The packet ticks Section 17 only. production-field-map.json refuses Section 16, Section 18 and Section 19.a with the string 'A participant election or financial fact not determined by this packet route' and routeDetermined: false. That reason is untrue of this route: those three printed grounds ARE this route's other declared dispositions. participant-instructions.md never mentions Section 16, Section 18 or Section 19.a. It names only Section 17 and a negative election of Section 15. A participant on this track whose disposition is supervision, qualified probation, or unrevoked conditional discharge or probation -- four of the track's five dispositions -- is handed a petition that states the wrong ground and is told nothing about which box states theirs, on a document they verify under 735 ILCS 5/1-109. Its printed title on page 1 is 'NORTH DAKOTA PARDON ADVISORY BOARD APPLICATION TO PARDON ELIGIBLE MARIJUANA OFFENSES', and its printed items 1, 2 and 3 are marijuana-specific certifications -- a request for an unconditional pardon with removal of guilt 'for the offense of possession of a controlled substance-marijuana, possession of marijuana paraphernalia, or ingestion of marijuana', a certification of no prosecution for intent to deliver, delivery or manufacture, and the five-year no-other-conviction certification. SERVICE.detail: Measured and satisfied, and satisfied trivially rather than unreachably. This is an application to an executive-branch agency board, not a court filing, so there is no opposing party to serve and no proof-of-service instrument.
